svg.title: Skateboard, side view, facing right, drawn to the rider: 192 px of deck with a kicked nose and tail (80 cm at the rig scale of 2.55 px/cm, where the old deck was 60 cm), two trucks 92 px apart and two wheels 22 px across. The wheel is exaggerated on purpose - a scale wheel is 5 px - and the wheelbase is not, because it is where the rider's feet go: front boot over the front truck, back boot over the rear one. The deck top is y 424 and the wheels touch the ground line at 460 with no offset. The board is one part and the rider stands ON it, so it draws behind the boots. Vancouver seawall: assets/style/vancouver-level.md.
